posts.text:

🏷 CME SCORE: C-type (500–999 km/s)
📐 CME half-angle: 31° (Moderate)

Data: NASA DONKI + NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center

posts.title: Evening Sunwatch
posts.text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — September 10, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B4.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B8.1 (Peaked September 10, 2026 at 20:07 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 441 km/s (Moderate)

#FreeSunny 🌞✊☀

Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
